verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26686406 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318762 (2026-10-05). One line: 41,200 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6 (CMP-GAM-001) at 10.93 USD each, confirmed for 2026-11-13. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment, but the document also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: EXW Boise normally leaves freight, insurance and duties with the buyer, yet the note says the Seller prepays them and adds them to the invoice. The note also says DDP is not agreed. Check this against Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 section 4.1.
Freight, insurance and duties will be added to the invoice on top of the 10.93 USD unit price. No amounts are given.
The document has no issue date and no total value.
observations: Clean, typed single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The quantity column has no unit of measure.
The confirmed date column does not say whether it is a ship date or a delivery date.
Description text wraps over three lines: 'Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6'.
